problem: Which of the following is the graph of  $y={2}^{x-3}-2?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y={3}^{x-3}-2?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To plot the given function, we follow these steps:

- First, we plot the graph of $y={3}^{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943741/assets/b36493839db2b86dac7b73d64f058c9c185c6ef6717b9937a286dd96b46b3d14.png)

- To plot $y={3}^{x-3},$ we shift the graph of $y={3}^{x}$ horizontally by $3$ units to the right. The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(3,1),$ but the horizontal asymptote stays at $y=0.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943741/assets/1a8c220f94fdea96374a3a336d6262c4a272f4b630749dbf51c33bccf42ef46c.png)

- To plot $y={3}^{x-3}-2,$ we shift the graph of $y={3}^{x-3}$ vertically by $2$ units down. The point $(3,1)$ moves to $(3,-1)$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=-2.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13943741/assets/65a4e59ccc4bae7f2de681ce4820020a180d087c5257b6b41dd8830bee587230.png)
